company.name: Subol
company.shortDescription: Subol is an IoT hardware company focused on smart home and indoor air quality solutions.
company.description: Subol develops a gas leakage detection and shutoff system designed to identify leaks and prevent hazardous situations. The company’s solution includes remote control and alarm notifications, a secure connection module, and integration with third-party home automation systems. Featuring a clip-on regulator powered by long-lasting batteries, the system enables users to effectively mitigate gas leakage risks and enhance overall safety.

productsAndServices.description: A home gas detector that monitors propane, isobutane, and methane levels, providing audio alarms and app notifications to alert users of gas leaks.
productsAndServices.name: Subol Detector
